messages.subject: Exploration for GGIR workshop potential
parts:
Hi GGIR users,

I have been receiving questions about when I will be giving a GGIR workshop. I am quite busy, but if there is a lot of interest then there must be a way to organise it. Possibly with the help from some GGIR contributors and/or experienced users. So, let's explore this.

If you are interested in a GGIR workshop, then please respond to this message with your answers to the following questions:

Content:
1. Are you interested in lectures by me (and optionally other GGIR contributors) about what GGIR can do and how it works? yes/no
2. Are you interested in a basic introduction about R? yes/no
3. Are you interested in hands-on working together on real data with GGIR? yes/no
4. Are you interested in learning how you can contribute to GGIR with GitHub? yes/no  
5. Are you interested in discussions about accelerometer data analysis in general to guide future GGIR developments? yes/no
6. Are you interested in a mini-hackaton to work on GGIR together? yes/no
7. If you responded yes to more than one of the above, what would be the ideal balance for you?

Organisation:
8. Are you able to host the workshop and help minimise the organisational burden for me? yes/no. Here, it would be helpful for me if my expenses can be covered either by the hosting organisation or by workshop participants.
9. Are you interested in co-organising the workshop by taking responsibility for a part of the workshop?

Your needs:
10. Is there a specific week or date you would like the workshop to take place?
11. How much are you willing to pay as participation fee per person for a one-day workshop, including lunch and coffee?
12. How much are you willing to pay as participation fee per person for a two-day workshop, including lunch, coffee and one dinner, excluding accommodation?
13. In what country, state/province, and city are you based?
14. How far are you willing to travel for the workshop? only within same city; only within same state/province; only within same nation; or only within same continent.
15. How many people do you expect to be able to enlist for the workshop, including yourself?
16. Do you have any comments/suggestions?

Your responses to the above questions will hopefully give me some idea of what could be a viable plan.

Thanks,
Vincent

Best wishes,
Vincent
